test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Two straight lines CD and AB cut each other at point O . Angle AOD = 75 degrees. What is the value (in degrees) of angle AOC ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of angles on a straight line (Linear Pair) is always 180°.

Given ∠AOD = 75° and AB is a straight line.

∠AOC = 180° − ∠AOD

∠AOC = 180° − 75° = 105°.

**∴ The correct answer is 105°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Lines AB and CD intersect at O.

∠AOD = 75°

**Formula:**

The sum of angles forming a linear pair is 180°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/236d11c1c8307740e44f0ae6e0a9be07da2f2f902b7941bc387838cbbd121ad5.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Since CD is a straight line, ∠AOD and ∠AOC form a linear pair.

⇒ ∠AOC + ∠AOD = 180°

⇒ ∠AOC + 75° = 180°

⇒ ∠AOC = 180° − 75°

⇒ ∠AOC = 105°

**∴ The correct answer is 105°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Vertically Opposite Angles

When two lines intersect, the angles opposite to each other at the vertex are equal. Here, ∠AOD = ∠BOC and ∠AOC = ∠BOD.

Linear Pair Axiom

If a ray stands on a line, then the sum of the two adjacent angles so formed is 180°.

Complete Angle

The sum of all angles around a single point is always 360°.
